title: finding(types,cli): objectui validate does not judge nested nodes inside a page container's properties.children (or items[].children), the one child-list spelling the spec accepts
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a measured reach at a public door (class a: an author, or an AI, writes metadata that `objectui validate` passes and the platform's own lint refuses).
Reader who acts: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from objectui#10872 batch 6: the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (`5913225209`), escalated by the at-tier contract review of PR objectui#11222 (`5913444746`, ③ 1), which asked for it to be filed as its own card. ⛔ Not graded here.
Dedup: the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (open and closed, down to #4526) were grepped locally for `properties.children`, `z.array(z.unknown())`, `items[].children`, nested + validate/judge and `unjudged`: no card covers it (the only multi-hit rows are PR objectui#11222 itself and two closed PRs of the same card family).

## The defect

- **The rows.** At the `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` tag commit (objectstack `0f6dcac5e9`), `PageCardProps.children` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:836`) and `PageContainerProps.children` (`:439`, shared by `page:section` / `page:footer` / `page:sidebar`) are `z.array(z.unknown()).optional()`. So are `items[].children` on `page:tabs` and `page:accordion`.
- **objectui's arms take those rows by reference** (objectui#10872 batch 1, `packages/types/src/zod/public-blocks.zod.ts` `propsBag`), so `safeValidateSchema` (what `objectui validate` runs) and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` never look inside a child list written in the bag.
- **The spec closes it one layer up, by hand.** `packages/lint/src/page-walk.ts` at the same tag walks `properties.children` and `properties.items[i].children` and judges each nested node. objectui has no equivalent: at the merge-base of PR objectui#11222 there are 0 non-test reads of `properties.children` under `packages/types/src` or `packages/cli/src`.

## Measured reach

Measured by the objectui#10872 batch-6 dev with a one-off probe on source at PR objectui#11222's head (10 rows): `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` both answer success for `{ type: 'page:section', properties: { children: [{ type: 'element:text', properties: { content: 7, bogus: 1 } }] } }` and for an unknown nested `type` in the same slot, while the same child written node-level is refused (`invalid_union` at `children`). All bag rows passed; all node-level rows were refused.

## Why this matters now, and what changed

- On `main` before PR objectui#11222, a node-level `children` on the four containers was judged recursively (`BaseSchema.children`, `packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts:391`, a `z.lazy` over the node union). PR objectui#11222 refuses that spelling (the spec refuses it too; it is the second dialect the card's ruling A forbids). After it, **no accepted child-list spelling on the four containers is judged nested** by objectui's faces.
- `page:tabs` and `page:accordion` have been in the same state since objectui#9256: their node-level `children` is refused and `items[].children` is `z.array(z.unknown())`.
- So a page built the way the spec and the validator's own remedy text teach (blocks nested in `properties.children`) gets `Schema is valid!` from `objectui validate` for a malformed nested block, and the platform's lint then refuses it.

## What a fix looks like (a direction, not a ruling)

Either objectui's validator walks the bag the way the spec lint does (a page walk over `properties.children` and `properties.items[i].children`), or objectui's arms narrow those slots to the node union. The first keeps the arms equal to the spec rows by reference; the second judges more than the row does. Whether the spec row itself should type the slot is a `domain:spec` question for triage.

Dedupe words: `properties.children nested node not validated` · `bag slot children z.array(z.unknown()) objectui validate` · `items[].children unjudged safeValidateSchema`
